title: Add --with-claim-state parity to the orphan-discovery helper
body:
## Background

Part of the field-report batch-6 roadmap (#1386). Field evidence: the roadmap-first and orphan-fallback discovery helpers are documented as interchangeable siblings within the same phase, but only the roadmap helper can fold live claim state into its output; a caller trusting the orphan helper's output at face value can select and attempt to claim a candidate a live session claimed moments earlier, discovering the conflict only at the claim pre-check — precisely the race the roadmap helper's claim-state flag exists to prevent. The asymmetry is easy to miss because the two helpers otherwise look and behave so similarly.

Verified against current `main`:

- `src/scripts/discover-roadmap-graph.mts` has `--with-claim-state` (parsed line 2030; wiring 565-567; annotations 764-777 and 1271-1277; `LeafActiveClaim {present, stale, claimId, agentId, ownedByCurrentSession?}` lines 160-166) plus `--current-claim-id` (line 2052).
- `src/scripts/discover-orphan-filter.mts` (781 lines) has zero matches for /claim/i; its output is `OrphanCandidate {number, title, state, reason, url, autopilotSuitability}` (lines 106-112).
- The claim logic is mostly already exported from the graph helper: `annotateLeafClaimState` (1533-1589), `isClaimStaleByAge` (1623-1637), `buildTrustedAuthorPredicate` (1709-1722); only `buildCommentLoader` (~23 lines) and `buildClaimStateResolution` (~20 lines) are module-private.

## Proposed change

Add opt-in `--with-claim-state` (and `--current-claim-id`) to `discover-orphan-filter`, reusing the exported functions; either export the two module-private builders from the graph helper or lift the ~45 lines of loader wiring. Annotate each candidate with the same claim shape the roadmap helper emits (`present`, `stale`, `claimId`, `agentId`, `ownedByCurrentSession`). Update the orphan-fallback description in `idd-discover.instructions.md` to mention the flag with wording parallel to the roadmap path. Default output (flag absent) stays byte-identical to today.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Flag present; annotated output shape matches the roadmap helper's claim shape.
- [ ] Default (no-flag) output unchanged (existing tests/fixtures pass).
- [ ] Tests cover active-claim, stale-claim, and unclaimed candidates.
- [ ] `idd-discover.instructions.md` mentions the flag; `pnpm run build` output committed.
